subject: [PATCH v2 05/12] mm/collapse: state what a collapse may do in the policy

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new struct collapse_policy to store the policy decisions made by the caller before asking the kernel to collapse memory pages. The policy includes settings such as limits on empty, swapped-out or shared PTEs, whether to take strict rules for sub-PMD windows, and how hard to try for a destination folio. The patch removes the need for the kernel to look up who called it to make these decisions, instead allowing the caller to fill in the policy once per scan pass or call. This change simplifies the code and improves performance by reducing unnecessary checks.
